report:
Reviewed the complete trait_calls claim and all three associated tests against the current operator implementation and newly associated finalizer. Requirements are (1) proven overloadable operations remain resolved trait calls for primitive, generic and user-defined operands, (2) method identity, substitutions, explicit adjustments and result type survive completion, (3) overloadable cases never complete as Binary, and (4) primitive recognition is deferred to code generation with concrete substitutions.

Implementation: expr.rs routes binary CST through check_binary_operator. operator.rs excludes only lazy And/Or from trait lookup; its exhaustive map covers arithmetic, shifts, bitwise operations and comparisons. All other cases use core trait/method identity obtained by well_known::operator_method, validate/instantiate the signature for Self and Rhs, build StaticTrait ResolvedCall with function, trait_ref, owner arguments and empty method arguments, and retain the call behind an obligation-backed expression slot. The constructor contains no primitive shortcut. Comparison return signatures unify with bool; associated Output results use retained normalization relations. Additional signature predicates are submitted as obligations. Unsupported signatures and erroneous operands diagnose rather than introduce a Binary fallback. The sole Binary construction in this file is the excluded lazy-boolean path. Receiver adjustment explicitly emits Ref for reference receivers; adjust_argument emits required argument Ref after matching the signature. finalize.rs resolves expression slots, copies ResolvedCall without changing its kind, preserves function identity and dispatch, canonicalizes owner/method arguments through copy_ty, recursively copies explicit operands/adjustments, and resolves the expression result type. This finalizer behavior is now associated directly with the anchor. There is no typed-IR primitive recognition in these paths, which preserves the boundary needed by later codegen; this review does not claim a codegen backend is implemented.

Associated test evidence: comparisons_materialize_signature_required_shared_borrows checks fixture equal(u32,u32) and less(u32,u32) bodies are diagnostic-free completed ResolvedCall nodes, resolves eq/lt and PartialEq/PartialOrd identity, checks bool result, two operands, explicit shared Ref nodes and shared-reference types with dummy lifetimes. local_operator_impl_can_choose_distinct_rhs_and_output checks custom Left + Right has resolved add identity, Self=Left and Rhs=Right substitutions, Sum result, no diagnostics, and the external implementation partition trace contains LocalAdt. The captured fixture really declares that Add<Right> for Left implementation with Output=Sum. The symbol assertion resolves names and rejects UseSymbol indirection. Harness source runs the callback both cold and warm against Sage with live rustc metadata, not rustc solving Sage goals. These bodies have substantive assertions rather than placeholder checks.

The third associated test, todo::types_operators_trait_calls, remains explicitly TODO: it says ground primitive/user-defined operators are covered but generic operators and the full oracle matrix are pending. This is an honest partial-coverage declaration. It is not counted as executing or establishing generic behavior, full token/type combinations, non-ground substitutions or every adjustment case. Prerequisites for closing it are generic operator proof/output support sufficient for completed bodies and an associated oracle/test matrix checking identities, substitutions, adjustments and results across the remaining operator/operand forms. The captured unassociated primitive test provides additional context for Add/Shl concrete substitutions, but is not substituted for the associated test set or treated as closing that TODO. The ordinary constructor/finalizer is representation-generic and preserves Ty::Param; broader generic semantic correctness stays deferred. No N/A or TODO implementation entries were supplied, and no status was reclassified.

Commands executed for this review: cargo meta review start/read, cargo fmt after the one association-comment change, and cargo meta review record. This was source assessment; I did not execute behavioral suites or claim passing tests. The coordinator centrally owns execution/build and the required quality/sanity reviews. All additional semantic source dependencies used in this assessment are captured. After adding the finalizer association I restarted, inspected its full newly included source and verified every unchanged retained fragment against the previous inspected input. No production behavior changes or new suspected behavioral defects were identified. No edits remain requested for this anchor; the explicit test TODO remains visible.
